description: Cobertura da Rede Móvel de Comunicações Eletrónicas is a dataset listed in data.gov.pt, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Autoridade Nacional de Comunicações. O conjunto de dados disponibiliza a cobertura potencial das redes móveis de comunicações eletrónicas em Portugal Continental, resultante da informação reportada pelos operadores à ANACOM, nos termos do Decreto-Lei n.º 40/2022, de 6 de junho, e da Portaria n.º 77/2023, de 14 de março. Coverage: Autoridade Nacional de Comunicações. The publisher named on the listing is Autoridade Nacional de Comunicações. Its keywords include rede-movel, telecom. The listing shows 2026-07-07 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support telecommunication coverage and network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-dados-gov-pt.
